notes: Lexical rules for capability identification. Each rule is one regex signal searched in the tool's declared name + description (assumed_capability). Migrated verbatim from capability_normalizer.RULES; patterns were not reworded. Editing these files changes capability identification on the next analysis run.

rules.reason: Controls hardware/IoT devices causing real-world changes.
Tool name follows the common smart-home/IoT domain-control naming convention (e.g. lights_control, climate_control), even when the description is a terse feature list rather than a sentence.

Terse product-style feature vocabulary real smart-home integrations use to describe physical device state (brightness/color for lights, tilt/open-close for covers, dock/fan-speed for vacuums, HVAC for climate).
